# Independent audit: seven actual fibers and global partial-trace depth

Audited source:
seven-actual-fibers-partial-traces-determine-global-depth-root.md.
Result: PASS after a full mathematical read and independent exact
rerun of verify_seven_fiber_global_partial_trace_depth_root.py.
The verifier reports 12468 exact coupled-cap, cover, uniqueness,
and parameter-transition checks.

1. The quadrilateral inequalities give exactly two integer bases
at z_1=-1, two at z_1=0 and three at z_1=1. Its three added
bases are exposed by the displayed integer functionals. Since
all continuous generators are contained in T, the actual core
fibers remain exactly T, and the three extreme fibers have their
assigned shapes. The body is full dimensional and has precisely
the stated positive-volume integer fibers.

2. The q=(0,0) lower bound retains one actual halfspace. If its
owned R trace is full, the paired endpoint cost is 2Gamma a for
the centered simplex copies, or exactly a for centered symmetric
copies. If that trace is not full, its opposite core partner's
threshold is strictly below the reflected level 2u.g-min_T u.x.
Thus the own-plus-partner profile pays (Gamma+rho_d)V. The two
alternatives are correctly separated, and no contribution is
counted twice. The vertical bound follows from Gamma+rho_d<1.

3. The canonical upper cap captures all R because h>b_0, cuts
each endpoint at its true centroid, and leaves only supporting
zero-volume traces on the adjacent core fibers. Raising its
threshold at a noncentroid q point strictly decreases the own
T contribution and cannot increase either endpoint or R cost.
This proves the complete local upper bound and uniqueness.

4. The other-anchor isolators are correct on ALL seven bases.
For delta_01 the values on (r,p,p') are (1,-1,5); for delta_10
they are (2,3,-1). Each is positive on every other core vertex.
Consequently the finite tilt 2 retains just the owned addition
and own canonical cap. The (1,1) isolator and all three exposed
vertical caps account for every remaining candidate. This proves
the global formula Gamma V+max(a,w+theta a), including all three
transition cases and the precise maximizing set at equality.

5. The two shrinking families have exactly equal masses and
identical conditional weak limits delta_g, but their normalized
global first-order derivatives differ by (1-2Gamma)/4. The atom
lies on all the canonical centroid boundaries, so this refutes
only a boundary-unqualified weak-law formula. It does not refute
the atomless partial-tail response theorem.

6. The extra binary-coordinate product is legitimate. Restricting
any ambient cap to a chosen binary copy gives the lower bound;
a finite exposing integer tilt excludes every other copy and
extends each original cap for the upper bound. Zero restricted
normal simply gives a whole copy and does not lower the bound.
All fibers retain full d-volume and the multiplicity normalization
is exactly 2^(n-2). No arbitrary continuous tensorization is used.

No correction was needed. This is an exact scoped source family,
not an OC counterexample or a reduction of general bodies to it.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
